tutorial.title: Custom Case & Popstand Preview Guide
tutorial.subtitle: Follow the instructions below for the best customization results
tutorial.step1Title: Step 1 : Choose Device Type, Model & Color
tutorial.step1Desc: Select your device category, phone model (e.g. iPhone 17 Pro Max or iPhone 16), and favorite device color from the studio panel on the right.
tutorial.step2Desc: Upload 1 to 3 portrait photos in transparent PNG format using the round upload button on the left sidebar.
tutorial.step2FormatDesc: Use transparent PNG photos (no background) for a seamless print finish. You can easily remove backgrounds for free at remove.bg.
tutorial.step3Desc: Choose your preferred layout formation (such as Staircase Zigzag) to combine stickers seamlessly across the case.

disclaimer.title: Preview & Print Disclaimer
disclaimer.desc: The customizer preview is a digital simulation. Actual physical print colors may slightly vary due to screen display settings, and sticker placement is proportionally adjusted to fit your device's camera module. Every order undergoes strict quality control to ensure maximum precision and print quality.
